values.task_boundary: Issue #487 AWS-D only; produce the audit/security baseline and proof. Do not perform multi-account rollout, application security redesign, website/DDNS/public-edge/runtime workload changes, GCP work, or speculative cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Account changes are durably observable
AC-2: Security findings have an owner and destination
AC-3: Retention and encryption are explicit
AC-4: Sensitive values are excluded from retained proof
AC-5: Logging cost and regional scope are explicit
AC-6: Fresh exact-head review has no actionable findings before publication
dependencies: AWS-C #486 terminal Terraform bootstrap backend and deployment-role prerequisite
non_goals: Website, DDNS, public-edge, or workload deployment
